title: Publication of The Federalist
summary: On this day, the Federalist papers—a series of 77 essays defending the proposed new U.S. Constitution and discussing the nature of republican government, written in 1787–88 by Alexander Hamilton, James Madison, and John Jay—were published in book form as The Federalist. The essays explored a wide range of issues, including judicial review, foreign policy, taxation, militias, separation of powers, elections, treaties, and why the Articles of Confederation were not sufficient to hold the country together. The remaining eight essays appeared in New York newspapers between June 14 and August 16, 1788.
